faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Uttarakhand Forest Department Working Plan Associate posts?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of applications for the Working Plan Associate posts is 12th August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Working Plan Associate post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc. degree in Botany, Zoology, Forestry, Wildlife, or Soil Science from a recognized university with a first division (at least 60% marks).

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Working Plan Associate recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Working Plan Associate post is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST/OBC/Woman candidates as per Uttarakhand State Government rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Working Plan Associate position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 25,000 per month, plus HRA.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Working Plan Associate post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Working Plan Associate post in the Uttarakhand Forest Department.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and submit it via post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Working Plan Associate recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves Application Scrutiny followed by a Personal Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of the Uttarakhand Forest Department. Links are provided in the Important Links section.

faq.answer: The interview date for the Working Plan Associate posts is scheduled for 17th August 2026.
